text: Anna Krzeptowska-Żebracka (26 July 1938 – 1 December 2017)[1] was a Polish cross-country skier who competed in the women's 10 kilometres event at the 1960 Winter Olympics. She is the sister of Zofia Krzeptowska.[2] This biographical article about Polish cross-country skiing is currently a stub and can be expanded with additional information on Wikipedia.
